cause: Despite the historical test name, attempt.pid is the durable attempt_runner, NOT the detached coordinator or writer. After runner SIGKILL the surviving coordinator asynchronously reaps and imports, publishing blocked/recovery_required plus the original attempt's ownership_ambiguous status while the child may remain live. The test assumed .1s implied that phase was persisted. Service.resume called while still running first performs import_durable and returns ownership_ambiguous/launchedfalse; only the already-blocked branch validates and returns the typed retain_ownership disposition. The safety response is correct; the test's ordering assumption is not.

The spawned coordinator's in-memory import method pauses only on the original third implementer after wait_durable has reaped the killed runner, then calls its unchanged original importer.
